goal: Maximize live-model triage accuracy on the v2 judgment-heavy library while holding latency low

metric.keep_rule: urgency improves AND category >= baseline_category - 0.05 AND p50 <= baseline_p50 * 3

notes: Baseline @ main: urgency 0.64, category 0.91, p50 0.616s (live Nova Lite us-east-2). All misses are urgency undertriages.
